Item.Description: If a suspension rate exists for the Commodity Code for goods from the appropriate country
Goods intended for use in the construction of aeroplanes of an unladen weight exceeding 15,000kg
Goods intended for use in the maintenance or repair of aeroplanes of an unladen weight exceeding 15,000kg
Goods intended for use in the maintenance or repair of aeroplanes and helicopters of an unladen weight exceeding 2,000 kg but not exceeding 15,000kg

Goods for use in the construction in the European Community of aeroplanes or helicopters or in the maintenance or repair of aeroplanes or helicopters constructed in the European Community or for use in aeroplanes or helicopters imported duty free.
Goods subject to end-use other than those covered by C-J above
Goods subject to suspension with an airworthiness certificate
